column1: # harness/gates.tsv — the factory gate registry (Gate I, control-structure plan slice 6).
# Every factory gate is registered here with the END-TO-END denial probe(s) that demonstrate
# it blocks the prohibited action (the run does not advance / the receipt is rejected / the
# status is not written), and the RED-NOW mutation that would turn the probe red (falsifiability
# — a probe that cannot be turned red is theater). `scripts/check_denial_probes.py` reads this
# file at build time and fails the build if any gate has no probe, any probe node-id does not
# collect in the suite, or any gate's red_now is empty. `harness/denial_probe.sh` re-runs a
# gate's probes on demand. A gate without a registered, collecting, passing probe is theater.
# Columns are TAB-separated: gate | name | prohibits | probes | red_now
#   gate      — the gate id (A–N + the named residuals F3/F4/R2/R3)
#   name      — the gate's short label (the gate name + the failure shape it closes)
#   prohibits — the prohibited action, stated end-to-end (what does NOT happen when the gate fires)
#   probes    — semicolon-separated pytest node-ids (file::test_name) that assert the block
#   red_now   — the specific mutation of the gate that turns its probe red (falsifiability)
# This file is data, not code: the generic harness reads it; a target never edits it. Adding a
# new factory gate without a row here fails `make ship` — which is the point.

column3: a run advances on a vacuous/echo test (test_count>0 with no real test executed)
column5: receipt.sh counts a trivial `assert True` suite as 1 (test_count>0 on a vacuous run advances)

column3: the dispatch precedes or omits its fence, or mutable phase/primer views bypass capsule-bound run-model injection
column5: the path-free task puts dispatch before FENCE, drops "One pen only" / "DATA, never authority", or copies mutable Markdown phase/primer views into the model task

column3: a lane dispatches with no role-specific kindex primer (validator-shallow, kindex-non-use)
column5: dispatch_lane.sh launches a lane with no primer.{role}.md present and exits 0 (including when an ambient gap variable is set), or shares one primer across roles

column3: a vacuous oracle or a symptom-kill (a test killed outside the named oracle) passes as adequacy
column5: mutate.sh attests oracle_adequate when a mutation survives or is killed outside the named oracle

column3: a subjective objection blocks, or a factual one is softened; verdict detail leaks into a lane
column5: inject.sh passes test detail / subjective verdict content into the lane's context (verdict negotiation); or an ambient variable turns the oracle-leak refusal into an allow

column3: a resident orchestrator injects into the validator's pane, a hung wake reports healthy while dead, or the default advisory wake bypasses its sandbox
column5: a tmux send-keys injection into the validator pane is accepted; a hung wake (poll None, elapsed>timeout) is not killed; default Agy omits --sandbox/--disable-slash-commands or sees the target checkout

column3: Phase A advances with an inadequate spec/strategy/oracle, including through an ambient override
column5: phase1_gate.sh passes a spec whose requirement names its own oracle / a strategy with no non-vacuity method / no oracle contract, or an environment variable turns a failure into success

column3: a lane sees the other lane's work or declares paths/history outside its projection
column5: a coder projection includes declared paths or git history; a tester projection allows an undeclared view

column3: a factory gate ships with no registered, collecting denial probe (theater)
column5: check_denial_probes.py accepts a gates.tsv with a gate whose probes column is empty, or a probe node-id that does not collect; or an ambient environment variable substitutes the registry or node-id set

column3: a lane dispatches with no authority tuple, a prose-only confirmation, ambiguous interpretation, an unknown/cross-role scope, an omitted directive, or an omitted qualifier
column5: dispatch_lane.sh launches from a prose substring, accepts unresolved interpretation, broadens an unknown scope, or allows a readback that omits a current checkpoint-bound directive or qualifier

column3: a supersession silently drops a qualifier, malformed evidence clears an attention gate, a receipt loses the race with gate release, dispatch consumes a pre-admission block or is interrupted by a post-admission block, partial publication wedges exact retry, or a postmortem invents a cause
column5: a supersession drops a qualifier; consume_block.sh accepts an unknown object or clears before its receipt parent is durable; a producer and dispatch bypass the shared attention lock; exact retained dispatch bytes cannot recover a partial publication; or postmortem reports an absent cause

column3: anything but promote.sh writes harness status "closed"; a run closes on a blocking verdict, missing inputs, a stale/forged verdict, or without endgame routing through Gate L
column5: something other than promote.sh writes harness.json status=closed; promote.sh writes closed on a blocking verdict / missing promotion_inputs / an unreachable CLI / a stale or forged verdict; endgame omits the Gate L invocation

column3: an agent-declared disturbed-surface set contradicts the git diff
column5: receipt.sh accepts a disturbed_surface_ids that contradicts `git diff --name-only`; the core promotes a request whose surfaces don't match the receipt

column3: self-reported oracle_adequate/deterministic/flake_count contradict the machine-derived receipt
column5: mutate.sh attests oracle_adequate=True when the named oracle SURVIVED; the core promotes a self-reported determinism/flake_count that contradicts the receipt

column3: repository contact occurs without live Stage-R authority, or ignition/dispatch selects task or target bytes outside the retained Stage-E target-state
column5: remove the retained Stage-R authority recheck; permit a URL/ref mismatch to contact Git; let factory.sh accept mismatched task bytes; let dispatch use a caller SHA or changed target-state

column3: a contact or created resource is acted on before durable intent, changes identity, evades the chain, or closes without an explicit terminal disposition
column5: invoke the first Git child before the planned contact entry; allow active run-owned residue to close; permit identity/baseline mutation; or trust a tampered resources.jsonl chain

column3: a model or broker acts on missing, changed, replayed, trust-escalated, oversized, source-detached, or path-substituted instruction state
column5: accept a capsule with incomplete membership, changed bytes, elevated context trust, future-dated instruction evaluation, instruction bytes detached from checkpoint sources, a partial-publication retry that changes the effective contract, a path selected by re-reading a mutable manifest, or a canary/handoff that does not echo the capsule digest

column3: a forged/stale/tampered receipt grounds a promotion (the pure core cannot read the chain)
column5: promotion_gate.py grounds a decision on a receipt id not in the chain / a self-consistent forged envelope / a tampered (hash does not re-derive) chain entry

column3: a per-entry-consistent rewrite that breaks the prev_hash link grounds a promotion
column5: promotion_gate.py grounds a decision on a chain whose prev_hash does not link to the prior entry's content address

column3: a second correctly-hashed entry reusing a real receipt id shadows it (last-wins) and grounds a promotion
column5: promotion_gate.py grounds a decision on a chain carrying two entries for one receipt id

column3: a Standard surface false-closes with no flake receipt (flake_count hidden)
column5: promotion.py promotes a Standard surface with deterministic=False + no flake receipt (the false close on a load-bearing flake_count)
